about: Highmark Foundry (caldera): the Bazookarp carrier's swim jumps over the lava, for the Bazookarp layout builder (karp-stages/). THIS LIST IS A LOWER BOUND: it holds every carrier crossing two searches found from their own take-off sets, and the Bazookarp checker's shortcut probes (#7d) must probe Highmark's Bazookarp layout itself (every edge of the carrier field, not these candidates) once it is built. The lead's decisions (caldera LEAD-NOTES, after reviews 6 and 7): a carrier swims its own ink (SPEC S21, 9.44 m/s), so its swim jumps over the lava are skill movement like everyone's; what a carrier may bypass is judged PER STAGE by #7d: the layout must place the Pond, the weirs and the Gate so no carrier jump saves over 20 m on the carrier field or skips a weir, with rails where it must (squids pass rails: a rail stops the kid's hop, not the swim). Its dash jumps are out (a carrier holds no sub); a Mitts leap is out too (no leap while carrying, actor.js). Fix round 7 merged (review 7 issue 4): (1) 'audit' = tools/botlab/tests/lava-audit.js rule 44's carrier row with PAGE_ARGS full=1 at the fix-round-7 geometry: every plain swim crossing the kid makes from the march's take-off nodes saving > 10 m, tried again with actor.carry set from the same take-off, run-up and heading; (2) 'probe-carry44:r6' / ':r7' = review 6's probe-carry44 run at the same geometry over review 6's candidate set (805 LOW / 362 HIGH swim crossings of the older audit) and review 7's rebuild (242 / 279), each tried with the carrier's movement from 2.6 m behind its edge along its heading (the probe's own landing rule: the far floor's height). Entries are deduplicated by take-off (0.1 m) and heading (22.5 deg); 'src' says which search found each; 'gain' = the nav walk from the take-off node to where it landed minus the flight, the largest the searches measured ('kidGain' beside it: the plain kid's). Both halves (x, z in world metres; Bravo's are the 180-degree turns).
